extracted.intended_audience: members of the press; journalists and media outlets
extracted.subtask_short: press media usage and contact guidelines
extracted.subtask_description: Brief official guidance for journalists about use of images from Google's press page and how to contact Google for press inquiries, plus direction for non-press queries. Focused on permissible image credit and the appropriate contact channel and eligibility for response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image usage and credit
rubrics_metrics.description: Images on this page may be used for publication with credit: "Source: Google."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When publishing images from this page, credit must be given as: "Source: Google." No additional licensing details are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press inquiries contact and response policy
rubrics_metrics.description: For press inquiries, email press@google.com. Only members of the press will receive a response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided press email for media inquiries; note that Google will only respond to individuals identified as members of the press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-press inquiries routing
rubrics_metrics.description: For all other inquiries please visit Google's Help Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-media questions should be directed to Google's Help Center rather than the press contact address.
